def factor_ema_momentum_regime_vol_amplified(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    ema_ret = daily_ret.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    is_high_vol, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    signal = ema_ret * vol_ratio
    signal = np.where(is_high_vol > 0, signal * 1.2, signal)
    signal = pd.Series(signal, index=df_copy.index).ffill().fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_ema_momentum_regime_vol_amplified"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_ema_momentum_regime_vol_amplified"]
description: Mutation of factor_ema_momentum_regime_vol. Preserves parent strength: EMA momentum trend (span=10) multiplied by relative volume ratio (vol_ratio from classify_volume_regime). Bottleneck targeted: symmetrical volume modulation may not fully exploit high-volume conviction periods where momentum is more reliable. A lightweight amplification (1.2x) is applied when volume is classified as high (is_high_vol > 0), sharpening the signal during high-conviction breakouts while retaining continuous cross-sectional variation. No new features; uses the existing regime flag from the tool. This is a minimal, bounded modification that keeps the core mechanism intact.
